name: WMT2016 News Translation — blind test set
description: WMT2016 News Translation blind test set, fetched on demand via sacreBLEU (`sacrebleu -t wmt16 -l <pair> --echo src,ref`; pinned sacreBLEU 2.6.0). One of the field's canonical HELD-OUT blind sets — the clean tier that complements our public dev splits. Covers news journalism. Scored against the PRIMARY reference (ref[0]); each sacreBLEU langpair is a distinct directed corpus (en-de → eng→deu, de-en → deu→eng). Domain 'news' (the WMT News Translation task).

download.instructions: Fetched on demand via sacreBLEU: `sacrebleu -t wmt16 -l <langpair> --echo src,ref` (pinned sacreBLEU 2.6.0). sacreBLEU verifies the upstream archive md5; Champollion never hosts the content.

source.citation: Findings of the 2016 Conference on Machine Translation (WMT16). statmt.org/wmt16.

license.aiTraining: Released for research evaluation; not licensed for unrestricted AI training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: WMT shared-task test data is distributed for RESEARCH use; the references are professionally produced but the underlying sources and terms are not blanket-permissive. Tagged commercial=false / redistribution=false so it stays out of every prize, commercial, and API lane (license_use.py). Champollion never hosts the content — sacreBLEU fetches it from source on demand. transmissionPolicy 'no-train' (founder decision 2026-07-19, docs/IP_TRANSMISSION_REVIEW_2026-07-19.md §6): WMT distributes these test sets FOR research evaluation — evaluation is the license's stated purpose, so remote model-API evaluation proceeds without a per-dataset upstream ask, restricted to no-train channels (docs/DATA_BOUNDARIES.md §'Transmission to model APIs').

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out WMT benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. Research-use license — kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane; the content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: WMT2016 News Translation test set — public since 2016 and in essentially every frontier model's training crawl. Maximally memorized, so its scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute translation quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.
